result.instructions: Tools for Fiscalo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Check that my Fiscalo connection works and tell me whether it is sandbox or production."; "Find the customer with tax number 123456789 and show me their details."; "Create a draft invoice for this customer in my default series, with two lines of consulting at 80 EUR.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Fiscalo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fiscalo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fiscalo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fiscalo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. fiscalo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fiscalo_connection_test
tools.title: Test the connection
tools.description: Check that the API key works and show its environment (sandbox or production). Use this first. Fiscalo API: GET /connection-test.

tools.name: fiscalo_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers of the company behind the API key. Filter by name, tax number or your own external_id. Fiscalo API: GET /customers.

external_id.description: Filter by your own customer id.

tools.name: fiscalo_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer by its Fiscalo id. Fiscalo API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: fiscalo_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer (individual or company). Writes need production access on the company. Fiscalo API: POST /customers.

external_id.description: Your own id for this customer (used to find it again).

country.description: Two-letter country code, for example PT.

tools.name: fiscalo_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List products and services in the catalog. Fiscalo API: GET /items.

tools.name: fiscalo_get_item
tools.title: Get an item
tools.description: Get one product or service by its Fiscalo id. Fiscalo API: GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: fiscalo_create_item
tools.title: Create an item
tools.description: Create a product or service with its unit price and tax rate. Writes need production access on the company. Fiscalo API: POST /items.

unit.description: Unit label, for example un or h.

external_id.description: Your own id for this item.

tax_exemption_reason_id.description: Tax exemption reason id, when the tax rate is 0.

tools.name: fiscalo_list_tax_rates
tools.title: List tax rates
tools.description: List the global tax-rate catalog (read-only). Use it to find the tax_rate_id for an item or a document line. Fiscalo API: GET /tax-rates.

country.description: Two-letter country code, for example PT.

type.description: Tax type filter, as the catalog names it.

active_on.description: Only rates active on this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: fiscalo_list_document_series
tools.title: List document series
tools.description: List the document series of the company. A draft needs an active series (series_id). Fiscalo API: GET /document-series.

tools.name: fiscalo_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List documents (invoices, credit notes, quotes and others) with their status. Fiscalo API: GET /documents.

external_id.description: Find a document by your own id.

tools.name: fiscalo_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get one document with its lines, taxes, totals and status (draft or issued). Fiscalo API: GET /documents/{id}.

tools.name: fiscalo_create_document_draft
tools.title: Create a document draft
tools.description: Create a draft document for a customer in an active series. The draft is NOT issued: this tool cannot issue or cancel a document. Repeating the same call sends the same Idempotency-Key, so it does not create a second draft. Fiscalo API: POST /documents.

currency.description: Currency code. The API default is EUR.

reference_document_id.description: The document this one corrects or refers to (for credit and debit notes).

external_id.description: Your own id for this document. A repeated external_id returns the existing document.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key. When omitted, one is derived from the request.

tools.name: fiscalo_add_document_line
tools.title: Add a line to a draft
tools.description: Add a line to a draft document. Only drafts accept lines; issued documents return document_not_editable. A retry adds the line again: check the document first. Fiscalo API: POST /documents/{id}/lines.

item_id.description: Item id (from fiscalo_list_items). Leave out for a free-text line.

annotations.title: Add a line to a draft

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Fiscalo
prompts.description: What you can do with Fiscalo here, with example requests to try.
